description: Extracts key screencast screenshots (base64 JPEG) from a temporal window around a test failure or the end of the trace, resolved with their associated test step titles.

limit.description: Maximum number of screenshots to return (default 10)

lookback_ms.description: Lookback duration before failure in ms (default 5000)

lookforward_ms.description: Lookforward duration after failure in ms (default 1000)

trace_path.description: Absolute path to trace.zip, or a URL (https://) to download it from

name: extract_critical_frames
